alternatives.choice: Unqualified planned or executed procurement/product link
alternatives.cost: Planned orders and supplier offers would be confused with executed acquisition

alternatives.choice: Documented executed purchase/acquisition event associated with a medicinal product type, admitted only as a source-qualified candidate
alternatives.benefit: Keeps existing typed relation while separating intent, purchase, receipt and item identity
alternatives.cost: Does not encode planned intent, line-item quantity, batch or delivery; requires explicit transaction evidence

alternatives.choice: Create procurement line item, consignment and batch participation now
alternatives.benefit: Could answer quantity and batch questions after proper modeling
alternatives.cost: No agreed identity, evidence, cardinality or CQ contract yet; risks false precision

meaning: A particular executed purchase or acquisition activity is documented as concerning this medicinal product type. A source-qualified candidate statement is not verified world truth.
identity: Procurement event, medicinal product type, physical item/batch, order, purchase invoice, receipt and source record remain distinct; neither product type nor order identity yields batch identity.
temporal_scope: Executed purchase/acquisition evidenced by source record and transaction date; no receipt, supply, fulfillment or delivery follows from it.
global_bounds: 0..* provisional at both ends; no universal occurrence, existential, exact-one, functional or compliance axiom.
local_admission: An opted-in claim has one ProcurementActivity event, one MedicinalProduct type, one performed transaction status, one transaction date and one SourceRecord with purchase-invoice or acquisition-record evidence; source record graph remains candidate only.
native: Existing null stereotype and optional typed ends remain; full OntoUML Event and procurement line semantics pending.
owl: Existing proposed object property domain/range only in bounded review; no inference to receipt, batch or supplier qualification.
shacl: Local source-qualified candidate admission; unknown, planned or qualification-only evidence does not project.
no_implied_truth: planned order implies no executed procurement
supplier offer or qualification implies no executed procurement
purchase implies no receipt, fulfillment or delivery
source claim implies no verified default-world assertion
release_effect: One of 47 remaining original experimental proposals receives bounded interpretation; 46 remain after this choice. No complete-model acceptance.
